data.name: Elimas
data.long_meaning: The name Elimas comes from the Hebrew language, derived from the elements 'El' (God) and 'mas' (my). This name was borne by several characters in the Old Testament, most notably a priest in the Book of Malachi and a Levite in the Book of Chronicles. In both cases, Elimas is shown to be a devoted servant of God, dedicating his life to the service of the Temple.
